mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.class_code, c.category_code, c.name, c.price, c.address, c.star_rating_avg, c.single_introduce FROM CLASS c JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON c.class_code = r.class_code JOIN SCHEDULE s ON r.repeat_rule_code = s.repeat_rule_code WHERE TRUNC(s.class_date) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND s.sold_out_yn = 'N' AND s.remaining_people > 0

SELECT DISTINCT c.class_code, c.category_code, c.name, c.price, c.address, c.star_rating_avg, c.single_introduce FROM CLASS c JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON c.class_code = r.class_code JOIN SCHEDULE s ON r.repeat_rule_code = s.repeat_rule_code WHERE TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'DY', 'NLS_DATE_LANGUAGE=AMERICAN') IN ('SAT', 'SUN') AND s.class_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND s.sold_out_yn = 'N' AND s.remaining_people > 0
SELECT class_img_code, class_code, type, image, sort_order FROM CLASS_IMG WHERE class_code = #{classCode} ORDER BY sort_order ASC
